title: Supreme Court Allows Execution of Christa Pike, Tennessee’s Lone Woman on Death Row
summary: Christa Pike tortured and murdered a classmate in 1995. She had been set to die on Wednesday, the first woman executed in the state in 200 years, until a lower court paused the execution.
